description: 81 days until the June 2 primary election!Saturday March 21st we’re launching our first canvass in Auburn, and we’re inviting supporters to help kick things off. No experience is needed, we’ll provide a quick training before heading out to talk with voters.Bring a friend, wear comfortable walking shoes, and bring your phone.We’ll have coffee and small bites ready for everyone before we head out.or go to: https://www.mobilize.us/nevaparkerforassembly2026/event/920575/
